label: src
quotes: App

The App module is the top level React entry component that wires together and renders the design system for preview, exporting a single App operation with no recorded internal call relationships or requirements yet.
DataTable
A UI component module that renders a tabular data display named DataTable, with no further functional detail recorded.
Legend
The Legend module provides a UI component that renders a legend explaining the colors, symbols, or categories used in an associated chart or visualization.
scale
Provides scale construction logic used to map data values to visual coordinates for chart organisms like dumbbell, heatmap, line, and scatter charts.
tones
The Tones module defines a set of tone values used elsewhere in the project, with no further requirements documented yet.
useNumberFormat
Documented the Use number format module, a hook providing number formatting logic for consumption by UI components.
Bullets
Bullets is a UI component module responsible for rendering a bulleted list element within the presentation layer, though no detailed requirements or sub-declarations have been recorded yet.
Button
Button is the atomic UI component providing the library's standard clickable button element.
Count
A minimal UI component module providing a Count element, with no recorded requirements beyond its single declaration.
Image
A React component module rendering an image element, with no further implementation details recorded.
Logo
A UI component that renders the application's logo graphic.
MenuItem
Documents a single UI component representing a selectable item within a menu.
